mapper.select: select id, order_no, operation_type, status, retry_count, next_retry_time, last_error, create_time, update_time, is_deleted from inventory_operation_task where status = 0 and next_retry_time <= now() and is_deleted = 0 order by id limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update inventory_operation_task set status = #{status}, retry_count = #{retryCount}, next_retry_time = #{nextRetryTime}, last_error = #{lastError}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and status = 0 and is_deleted = 0
